name: Pinned Down Combat Awareness

source.bodyComments: hearGunfire describes TEST15 group processing; comments do not establish a later installed version.

scope: All14 recovered readable config/startup/settings/runtime/debug bodies inspected. Only this extracted snapshot, not missing PBO packaging/compiled equivalence, licence clearance or physical acceptance. CBE HearingLocal fully read; selected listener init/stop/locality and area-report contract compared, not every downstream area-response executor.

dispositions.source: Explicit compile/XEH startup; CAManBase/LandVehicle/Air/Ship Fired class handlers; per-machine init guard; CBA settings registration.
dispositions.decision: Retain event-driven locality intent through existing CBE leader FiredNear listener and its owner cleanup. Do not add a second global Fired intake or import startup/config dependencies.

dispositions.source: Normalises Fired layouts5/6 and actual gunner group; one accepted event per firing-group cooldown before sound classification; scans allGroups and filters local hearing groups, optional player exclusion and friendly-fire hearing.
dispositions.decision: Keep native source/platform eligibility and recipient locality intent. Existing CBE native FiredNear callback has a different documented layout and range. Reject global allGroups scans; sender-group gating can let a quiet first shot suppress a later loud source-group cue. Keep CBE recipient cadence and uncertain area, no new sender roster.

dispositions.source: Attachment presence, mode soundTypeIndex, sound-name signatures, low audibleFire and hard-coded SOG weapon aliases classify quiet fire. Generic two-entry sounds alone is explicitly not sufficient, but name signatures can still overclassify.
dispositions.decision: Adapt selected-sound intent, improve metadata resolution. Use native ItemInfo soundTypeIndex to select the actual event muzzle/mode sounds entry; no arbitrary presence or substring/weapon-name alias. Supported quiet class must exist. Existing low positive audibleFire policy remains. Unknown/legacy/custom metadata needs separate evidence, not guessed compatibility.

dispositions.source: Within configured1000m/100m ranges, leader spotDistance/spotTime skillFinal affects tiny reveal gain; unbounded hearingKnowledge rows accumulate per source group with no decay and reveal the current firing platform up to knowledge4.
dispositions.decision: Reject indefinite source-group identity accumulation and object reveal from anonymous sound. Preserve authored skills and existing quantised50m CBE area reports with20s expiry; actual native FiredNear reach and10s accepted recipient cadence remain. Wider anonymous hearing remains a capability gap, not full source parity.

dispositions.source: Every sync writes each local setting publicly; callbacks can originate on each machine.
dispositions.decision: Do not import a parallel settings transport or let joining machines rebroadcast stale defaults. Existing CBE authoritative CBA configuration remains.

dispositions.source: Bounded trace/error text, counters and clipboard actions. Debug installs a0.5s PFH that remains installed when disabled; error/action cleanup is not a complete lifecycle.
dispositions.decision: Use existing CBE diagnostics. Do not import permanent per-source debug workers, player addAction/hint surfaces or raw source UI.

implementation.change: Infantry inspect at most16 native weapon rows, select the event weapon attachment and read ItemInfo soundTypeIndex (default0 absent). Resolve event muzzle/mode with weapon-mode fallback. Finite nonnegative integer in-range index selects one sounds entry; only an existing canonical quiet sound class qualifies. A sole/first quiet mode handles integral weapons; normal paired modes with index0 remain ordinary. Vehicle events skip infantry inventory.
implementation.preserved: No global hook, world/group scan, identity/reveal/skill write, new cache/controller/worker/timer or hearing-range increase. Existing eligibility, hostile source-side, cooldown,20m quiet cutoff,50m quantisation and20s report expiry remain.

nativeConfigEvidence.meaning: Normal native base modes expose both variants; presence of SilencedSound is not evidence that it is selected. Config snapshot only, not final merged runtime config.

validation.meaning: Static source contracts and compilation/package verification; no Arma execution or acoustic propagation proof.

remaining: Native/legacy/custom sound metadata and actual perceived audibility require physical testing. Canonical sound names are declared intent, not measured volume.
Long-range anonymous sound observation, skill-sensitive uncertainty and broader sensing remain independent capability decisions; no source-wide behaviour parity claimed.
Recipient owner/leader changes, normal/HC, repeated cue balance and whole-runtime performance remain unverified.
Original PBO/container history and reuse licensing are separate from readable extracted-source availability.
